tagline: River Road, keeping the James in sight toward Richmond.
intro: Route 6 leaves Scottsville along the river and the rail line, then climbs out of the valley as River Road and runs east through Kidds Store and Cohasset to Fork Union. Past Holmhead it crosses the Rivanna into Columbia, follows the James a while into Goochland County, and comes back to the river at the courthouse town of Goochland.
From there it carries on through the villages of Manakin and Sabot toward the western edge of Richmond, parallel to the James the whole way from Scottsville.

moments.title: Scottsville
moments.text: Once the largest port on the James River and Kanawha Canal, the town on the horseshoe bend later watched the railroad lay its tracks directly on the old towpath.

moments.title: Columbia
moments.text: At Point of Fork, where the Rivanna meets the James, von Steuben's men dumped their heavy guns in the river in 1781 to keep them from the Queen's Rangers.

moments.title: Goochland
moments.text: A county seat just north of the James, known also as Goochland Court House, in a county named for Sir William Gooch, royal lieutenant governor of the colony.
